atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines Tailwind CSS theme variables and their generated utilities.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing Tailwind CSS utilities into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom Tailwind CSS variant usable in templates and with @variant.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind CSS variant to the nested declarations.

atDirectives.name: @slot
atDirectives.description: Marks where a @custom-variant block places the styled rule.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom Tailwind CSS utility that supports variants.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Adds or excludes Tailwind CSS class detection sources.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Imports a stylesheet for @apply and theme access without emitting its CSS.

properties.name: text-decoration-skip-spaces
properties.description: Whether text decorations such as underlines skip spaces: none, all, or start and end of a line (CSS Text Decoration Level 4).
